annual.note: The denominator includes actual Class A and B shares plus unissued RSUs and PRSUs. Already-issued restricted shares are not counted twice. Options use DCF common value, with assumed 65% volatility and a 4% risk-free rate.
annual.noteZh: 分母包含实际A类及B类股数及尚未发行的RSU和绩效RSU，已发行限制股不重复计算。期权使用DCF普通股价值，并假设波动率65%、无风险利率4%。

limitations: IPO-period compensation distorts historical GAAP margins. Existing options and unissued awards are allocated separately; future employee compensation remains in operating margins.
limitationsZh: 上市期间股权薪酬扭曲历史GAAP利润率。现有期权和未发行奖励单独分配；未来员工薪酬仍计入营业利润率。
businessSummary: Community platform monetized through advertising and data licensing.
businessSummaryZh: 通过广告和数据授权盈利的社区平台。
rationale: Initial 25% growth is below recent reported expansion;35% mature GAAP margin assumes advertising monetization scales without removing recurring employee pay. Data licensing and advertising demand remain uncertain.
rationaleZh: 初期25%增长低于近期申报增速；成熟期35%GAAP利润率假设广告变现扩大且不剔除持续员工薪酬。数据授权及广告需求仍有不确定性。

growth.en: Initial 25% growth is below recent reported expansion;35% mature GAAP margin assumes advertising monetization scales without removing recurring employee pay.
